tools.name: bank-payments_uk-modulus-check
tools.description: Check whether a UK sort code and account number pair can be valid using Vocalink modulus weights (valacdos/scsubtab) and exceptions 1–14. Docs: https://www.brainiac.software/api/bank-payments/uk-modulus-check Keywords: Vocalink, before you send or validate a bank payment, sortCode, accountNumber, st

tools.name: bank-payments_sepa-creditor-id-validate
tools.description: Parse a SEPA Direct Debit Creditor Identifier and recompute ISO 7064 Mod 97-10 check digits (business code excluded). Docs: https://www.brainiac.software/api/bank-payments/sepa-creditor-id-validate Keywords: before you send or validate a bank payment, creditorId, country, checkDigits, expectedCheckD

tools.name: bank-payments_iban-from-bban
tools.description: Compute ISO 13616 check digits for a country code and domestic BBAN, then validate the resulting IBAN structure. Docs: https://www.brainiac.software/api/bank-payments/iban-from-bban Keywords: before you send or validate a bank payment, country, bban, ibanPrint, checkDigits, valid, expectedBbanLength

tools.name: bank-payments_uetr-validate
tools.description: Validate an ISO 20022 UETR as a UUID version 4, or generate one or more UETRs with crypto.randomUUID(). Docs: https://www.brainiac.software/api/bank-payments/uetr-validate Keywords: before you send or validate a bank payment, uetr, generate, count, valid, version, variant, normalised, reason, Valida

tools.name: bank-payments_postal-address-check
tools.description: Classify an ISO 20022 PostalAddress as structured, hybrid or unstructured and check Swift CBPR+ town/country/AdrLine rules. Docs: https://www.brainiac.software/api/bank-payments/postal-address-check Keywords: before you send or validate a bank payment, address, role, agentHasBic, messageType, format

tools.name: bank-payments_nacha-file-build
tools.description: Generate a 94-character NACHA ACH file (PPD/CCD/WEB/TEL) with batch hashes, totals and blocking-factor padding from JSON entries. Docs: https://www.brainiac.software/api/bank-payments/nacha-file-build Keywords: before you send or validate a bank payment, immediateDestination, immediateOrigin, destin

tools.name: bank-payments_nacha-file-validate
tools.description: Validate NACHA record order, lengths, ABA checksums, batch/file hashes and totals, reporting every structural error by line. Docs: https://www.brainiac.software/api/bank-payments/nacha-file-validate Keywords: before you send or validate a bank payment, file, maxErrors, valid, summary, errors, warnin

tools.name: bank-payments_camt053-parse
tools.description: Parse an ISO 20022 bank-to-customer statement or report into normalised JSON with balance reconciliation checks. Docs: https://www.brainiac.software/api/bank-payments/camt053-parse Keywords: before you send or validate a bank payment, xml, includeRaw, messageType, statements, checks, Parse camt.052/

tools.name: contact_us
tools.description: How to contact BRAINIAC.software support: email, page URL, what to include in a message, and what not to send. Free. Does not send email.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "bank-payments" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: bank-payments_postal-address-check · Private data: bank-payments_nacha-file-build, bank-payments_nacha-file-validate, contact_us · Public sink: bank-payments_uk-modulus-check, bank-payments_sepa-creditor-id-validate, bank-payments_iban-from-bban, bank-payments_uetr-validate, bank-payments_postal-address-check, bank-payments_nacha-file-build, bank-payments_nacha-file-validate, bank-payments_camt053-parse, contact_us · Destructive: bank-payments_postal-address-check.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: bank-payments_postal-address-check · Private data: bank-payments_nacha-file-build, bank-payments_nacha-file-validate, contact_us · Public sink: bank-payments_uk-modulus-check, bank-payments_sepa-creditor-id-validate, bank-payments_iban-from-bban, bank-payments_uetr-validate, bank-payments_postal-address-check, bank-payments_nacha-file-build, bank-payments_nacha-file-validate, bank-payments_camt053-parse, contact_us · Destructive: bank-payments_postal-address-check

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "bank-payments_uk-modulus-check" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
